scope.reviewed: null/non-null wrapper behavior, exact child args and fullword status propagation, frame restoration

findings.result: Independent decoding confirms the 20-byte entry returns 1 immediately for null context. Otherwise it sets R0=0, R1=5, R2=context and calls the adjacent 8-byte bridge, which forwards these arguments to 6BD4. The controlled child’s R0 status propagates through both wrappers. The exact two spans and R4/SP restoration match the candidate.

All 15 isolated fixtures pass and replay JSON matches byte-for-byte. Null path makes no child call; each non-null context invokes the child with exact arguments and returns each of five fullword statuses unchanged. Source/body/file pins and independent decode pass.

limitations: 6BD4 is controlled and unresolved; this proves wrapper argument and return behavior only.
The 15 cases cover three context values and five statuses; no hardware setup behavior or canonical admission is claimed.
